title: A Pre-Registered Falsification of a Speculative Multiverse Model (MULTIVERSE v1)
description: Complete public record (rules, data manifests, code, frozen results, timestamp proofs and paper) for a pre-registered test of version 1 of the Mandarano Model, a speculative model written for the WickedAI documentary MULTIVERSE. Version 1 is falsified through the decisive failure of its galaxy rotation-curve pillar in two independent pipelines. AI systems used in the work are credited in the README and paper.
